description_en: Queries the peak BPS and PPS data of DDoS network-layer attacks
name: DescribeDDoSBpsMax

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据的开始时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](url) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](url)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The protection region. If this parameter is not specified, the default value global is used. Valid values:

domestic: the Chinese mainland.

overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

global: global
parameters.help_zh:
防护区域，不填默认为global，填写时取值如下：

domestic：中国内地。

overseas：全球(不包含中国内地)。

global：全球
parameters.name: coverage

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range that was queried. The time is in ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is in UTC+0
EndTime.description_zh: 获取数据的结束时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

MaxAtkBps.description_en: The peak attack bandwidth. Unit: bit/s

MaxAtkPps.description_en: The peak attack PPS. Unit: pps

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC+0
StartTime.description_zh: 获取数据的开始时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
